description: This file defines the EntityType interface, which represents the type of an entity within the system. It emphasizes immutability and provides methods to create an EntityType from a CharSequence and to retrieve its value.

classes.name: EntityType
classes.description: An interface representing the type of an Entity, which is immutable and comparable, and can be converted to a CharSequence.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an EntityType instance from a CharSequence input, delegating to EntityTypes.getDefaultEntityType.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value representing the entity type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the entity type.
